text.tspan: Excess mortality: Raw number of deaths from all causes compared to
projection based on previous years United States
The reported number of weekly or monthly deaths in 2020–2024 and the projected number of deaths for 2020, which is
based on the reported deaths in 2015–2019.

tspan.tspan: Human Mortality Database (2023), World Mortality Dataset (2023)
The reported number of deaths might not count all deaths that occurred due to incomplete coverage and delays in reporting.
